description: This file defines the RandomData interface providing various methods for generating random data, including strings, integers, longs, and distributions, with some methods supporting cryptographic security. It is marked as deprecated and intended for use with RandomDataGenerator.

classes.name: RandomData
classes.description: An interface providing methods for generating various types of random data, including strings, numbers, and distributions, with support for cryptographically secure options.

methods.name: nextHexString
methods.description: Generates a random hex string of specified length, not cryptographically secure.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random long integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextSecureHexString
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random hex string of specified length.

methods.name: nextSecureInt
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextSecureLong
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random long integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Generates a random value from the Poisson distribution with given mean.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Generates a random value from the Gaussian distribution with specified mean and standard deviation.

methods.name: nextExponential
methods.description: Generates a random value from the exponential distribution with specified mean.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random value within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random value within specified bounds, with option for inclusive lower bound.

methods.name: nextPermutation
methods.description: Returns a random permutation of k elements from n.

methods.name: nextSample
methods.description: Returns a random sample of k objects from a collection.
